ssc_bw.footer.unofficial: This is an unofficial fan-made tool. Please do not report issues in the communities of the related modpack or mods.
ssc_bw.footer.disclaimer: All script algorithms are based on publicly available modpack data. This site does not host or distribute game files; download links point to CurseForge.

ssc_bw.station.craft_station.name: Craft Station
ssc_bw.station.craft_station.help: Works using the stats specified by each recipe. Different types / recipe variants use different speed and yield stats.
ssc_bw.station.craft_station.desc: Allows certain types of Pokémon to craft items.
ssc_bw.station.gardening_station.name: Gardening Station
ssc_bw.station.gardening_station.help: Performs in-world actions by work type. Action time = base time / speed multiplier. Grass crop growth requires the Growth Edition.
ssc_bw.station.gardening_station.desc: Allows certain types of Pokémon to perform in-world actions.
ssc_bw.station.gardening_station.type.gr: Grows farmland crops in an area around the station.
ssc_bw.station.gardening_station.type.wa: Waters farmland in an area around the station.
ssc_bw.station.gardening_station.type.no: Harvests milk and forages from nearby Ranching Stations.
ssc_bw.station.gardening_station.type.fa: Magically harvests drops from nearby Ranching Stations.
ssc_bw.station.gardening_station.type.fl: Harvests nearby berry bushes. Lower level workers have a chance to eat berries.
ssc_bw.station.gardening_station.type.da: Harvests experience candies by defeating nearby Pokémon.
ssc_bw.station.mystery_mine.name: Mystery Mine
ssc_bw.station.mystery_mine.help: Consumes berries and rolls loot by type / recipe. Score = speed multiplier × expected yield.
ssc_bw.station.mystery_mine.desc: Certain types of Pokémon can enter the mine to find ores, loot, and mob drops.
ssc_bw.station.crystal_ball.name: Crystal Ball
ssc_bw.station.crystal_ball.help: Psychic type. Sp. Atk determines speed, HP determines range; boosts yield / chance for nearby stations.
ssc_bw.station.crystal_ball.desc: Allows Psychic type Pokémon to increase the chances of other workstations.
ssc_bw.station.energy_pylon.name: Energy Pylon
ssc_bw.station.energy_pylon.help: Electric type. Sp. Atk determines speed, HP determines range; boosts speed for nearby stations.
ssc_bw.station.energy_pylon.desc: Allows Electric type Pokémon to increase the speed of other workstations.

ssc_bw.calc.mult.title: Yield Zone · {stat}
ssc_bw.calc.mult.noneBody: This recipe type has no yield zone; output is fixed.
ssc_bw.calc.action.title: Action Time · {stat}
ssc_bw.calc.range.title: Range · HP
ssc_bw.calc.score.title: Score and Gains
ssc_bw.calc.basis: Calculation basis: Lv.{level} / {iv} IV / {ev} EV / {nature} nature
ssc_bw.calc.recommend.equal: Speed Zone ({speed}) and Yield Zone ({mult}) provide equal gains
ssc_bw.calc.advice.ivMax: Current simulation {iv}/31 (maxed); if the real Pokémon's {stat} IV is not maxed, raise it to 31 first.
ssc_bw.calc.advice.ivNotMax: Current simulation {iv}/31; when training, raise the {stat} IV to 31 first.
ssc_bw.calc.advice.evText: After IVs are maxed, put remaining EVs into {stat}; at Lv.100 every 4 EVs = +1 stat, max 252 per stat.
ssc_bw.calc.note: Base stats are species base values; stat value = base stat after level, IV, EV, and nature. This page uses one shared IV/EV simulation; external Energy Pylon / Crystal Ball bonuses are not included.
ssc_bw.calc.reason.hpOther: HP is not affected by natures, so use a nature that boosts the other zone stat.
ssc_bw.calc.reason.hpOnly: The target zone is HP, which is not affected by natures; a neutral nature is recommended.
ssc_bw.calc.reason.noNature: No nature can safely boost the target stat; a neutral nature is recommended.
ssc_bw.calc.reason.better: Boosts {plus} ({zone}), while lowering {minus} does not affect this recipe.
ssc_bw.note.formula: Formula: Speed Multiplier = floor(Stat Value / 127.5 × 100) / 100, Shiny ×2; Yield % = floor(Stat Value / 127.5 × 100), Shiny ×2, Expected Yield = 1 + Yield % / 100; Range Radius = floor(clamp(Stat Value / 500 × 10, 0, 10)), Shiny ×2.
ssc_bw.note.action: Action Time = Base Time / Speed Multiplier; Gardening Station radius = clamp(Level / 10, 1, 10), horizontal range = radius × 2 + 1, vertical radius = min(2, radius).
ssc_bw.note.buff: Crystal Ball / Energy Pylon range is a cube: horizontal and vertical are both radius × 2 + 1.
ssc_bw.import.title: Import modpack data
ssc_bw.import.subtitle: Download the modpack and two mods from CurseForge, then drop the files here. Files are parsed only in your browser and are never uploaded.
ssc_bw.import.notice.title: This site does not host or distribute game files.
ssc_bw.import.notice.body: All download links point to the official CurseForge CDN. Only the lookup page and local parser are provided. Make sure you have permission to use the modpack and mods. After downloading, drop the files here.
ssc_bw.import.step1: 1. Select and download a modpack version
ssc_bw.import.packHint: After downloading, drop the .zip below, or click the area to choose a file.
ssc_bw.import.packDropHint: or click to choose a file (CurseForge .zip)
ssc_bw.import.step2: 2. Download and import the two mod jars
ssc_bw.import.modHintInitial: Import the modpack zip first; the page will read the required mod versions from manifest.json.
ssc_bw.import.modHintReady: The two mods specified by manifest.json. Download them, then drop the jars below.
ssc_bw.import.modManual: Download from the CurseForge file page
ssc_bw.import.jarDropHint: You can also drop the modpack zip and both jars at once
ssc_bw.import.detailsP1: The modpack zip is usually in your CurseForge downloads folder. The two jars are in the modpack instance's mods/ folder. You can also use the same files from an installed instance.
ssc_bw.import.detailsP2: If your browser says it cannot unzip files, use the latest Chrome, Edge, or Firefox.
ssc_bw.import.lookup: Looking up the two mod download links…
ssc_bw.import.allRead: All three files are loaded. Click “Parse and open site”.
